en: Colorized vintage postcard showing a calm river or canal in the foreground with reflections of moored boats. On the far bank stand several elegant, low-rise classical buildings with red roofs and trees around them, likely a riverside manor or small town quay. The sky is clear and lightly tinted, and there is a tall flagpole to the right. The left margin is partially obscured by a white block. The word "Mesothen" is printed in red at the top left.
